title: Deliver VC-201-092 operating-layer SLO event instrumentation and windowed sample publication in susi-gawd-a2a
goal: Instrument GawdA2AExecutor::execute and cancel to measure availability, task_success, queue_delay, inference_latency, and recovery_duration from actual task events, aggregate them into time-windowed SloSample records, and publish formatted SLOs with explicit denominators and unknown markers when samples are insufficient.
